title: Source-specific ingestion resolvers
description: Build a standard source-resolution utility for Biblicus ingestion so site-specific URLs, starting with DocumentCloud, resolve to canonical raw items, stable provenance, duplicate identity keys, and import rationale metadata before entering the corpus.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implementation started from approved plan: source resolver registry, DocumentCloud resolver, optional import rationale metadata, source-provided text extraction, and AI-ML-journalism smoke ingest.
